How it works

Three easy steps, every day

1

Start a session

Open the app, pick today's level, and follow the calm breathing guide. The whole session takes about 15 minutes.

2

Practice and play

Follow the pace on screen. Stay relaxed, keep a steady rhythm, and let the app cheer you on as you go.

3

See your score

Get a score out of 100, one simple tip for next time, and a badge when you beat your best. Small wins add up fast.

What you train

Four simple skills. That is all.

No hard words, no long lessons. Each skill is one small thing you can feel getting better, week by week.

01

Calm breathing

Slow, easy breathing helps you stay relaxed and in control from start to finish. The app guides every breath until it feels natural.

02

Steady rhythm

A smooth, steady pace feels good and builds trust. You practice keeping the beat, then making it your own.

03

Relaxed jaw

A soft jaw and relaxed face make everything more comfortable — for longer, with less effort. Gentle exercises, never strain.

04

Gentle control

Learn the difference between soft, just right and strong — and how to choose, smoothly, without thinking about it.

The 4-week game

One level a week. One win at a time.

Week 1

Level 1 — Find your calm

Learn the breathing guide and get used to the trainer. Short, easy sessions. No pressure to be perfect.

Win: finish 3 sessions and earn your first badge.

Week 2

Level 2 — Find your rhythm

Keep a steady pace for longer. Watch your rhythm score climb as it starts to feel easy.

Win: hold a steady rhythm for a full session.

Week 3

Level 3 — Stay relaxed

Longer sessions, softer jaw, calmer breathing. This is the week most women say it clicks.

Win: beat your Week 1 score by 15 points or more.

Week 4

Level 4 — Your best score

Put it all together and go for your personal best. Finish the game feeling proud and sure of yourself.

Win: your highest score yet — and the confidence that comes with it.

The girlfriends' challenge

Better together — and much more fun

Start the 4-week game with your girlfriends. You each practice at home, on your own. Then you share scores — only if you want to — cheer each other on, and laugh a lot along the way.

It is the talk of brunch for a reason: everyone wants to feel more confident. Now you can work on it together, like a fitness challenge — but far more fun to talk about.

Questions

Good to know

What exactly do I practice?

Four simple things: calm breathing, a steady rhythm, a relaxed jaw, and gentle control — soft, just right, or strong, when you choose. The trainer and app guide you, score you, and give you one easy tip at a time.

How much time does it take?

About 15 minutes a day, a few days a week, for 4 weeks. Each week is one level. You go at your own pace — pause or repeat a level any time.

Do I have to share my scores?

Never. Sharing is only for the girlfriends' challenge, and only if you start or join one. Your own scores stay in your app.

How does the $10 reserve work?

Leave your email above and we send you a reserve link. The $10 holds your kit at the $99 launch price and is fully refundable any time before your kit ships. No payment is taken on this page.

Is this a medical product?

No. It is a personal wellness and confidence trainer. It does not treat or cure any condition. If you have pain or a medical concern, please talk to a doctor or a qualified therapist.

Who is it for?

Women aged 18 and over who want to feel calmer and more confident in close moments with a partner — and who like the idea of learning as a fun, friendly game.
